about: Lines of .mjs code per package (architecture section 6). tests/acceptance/v5/integ-budget.test.mjs fails the build over budget. Only the integration owner changes this file, and every change from the architecture's number carries a reason here.

server.reason: 2026-11-17, integration owner: 1,178 lines before the review fixes, 1,262 after F08 (roots fail closed, private list re-read), F09 (one deadline across queue, dispatch and a worker-run safe mode), F11 (new app modules re-imported on a swap), F17 (private items merged under section limits and cited by pack), F18 and F22. Each is a correctness or safety rule with its own test; none is optional.
